audit.sql: SELECT a.content, a.date, a.total_plays, b.total_likes FROM (SELECT ubf.content_id AS content, DATE(ubf.timestamp) AS date, COUNT(*) AS total_plays FROM user_behavior_fact ubf WHERE event_type = 'play' AND DATE(ubf.timestamp) BETWEEN '2023-10-29' AND '2023-10-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY DATE(ubf.timestamp), ubf.content_id) a JOIN (SELECT ubf.content_id AS content, DATE(ubf.timestamp) AS date, COUNT(*) AS total_likes FROM user_behavior_fact ubf WHERE event_type = 'like' AND DATE(ubf.timestamp) BETWEEN '2023-10-29' AND '2023-10-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY DATE(ubf.timestamp), ubf.content_id) b ON a.content = b.content AND a.date = b.date ORDER BY a.date
